Stage via <root>/tmp/, never tempdir(). cross-device rename copy, atomic. Never hash serialize() output, never call digest() without serialize = FALSE. Identity comes explicit text encoding inst/spec/key-encoding-v1.md, frozen golden vectors versioned (KEY_ENCODING_VERSION). test greps R/ fails hit. Index encodings revisable; key encoding . Key tag length limits constants, derived page size. keysize_max 2022 bytes 4 KiB pages 8166 16 KiB, machine-derived limit makes macOS-written store unreadable Linux. KEY_MAX = 512, TAG_MAX = 256; longer keys digested canon kept meta record.
